theorem_title: Actual shortcut parity prefixes determine residue classes
natural_language_statement: Two naturals whose first k actual shortcut parity bits agree are congruent modulo2^k. If they are distinct, their natural absolute difference is at least2^k. Limitations: Finite actual-map statement, not a universal recurrence claim. Elementary classical parity arithmetic; no external priority claim.
